textos.Graba primero; la ficha se completa desp: Record first; fill in the entry later, calmly.
textos.1. Descarga la plantilla: es una hoja co: 1. Download the template: a spreadsheet with all of Vírgula’s texts and an empty column for the translation.
textos.2. Llénala en Google Sheets, Excel o Lib: 2. Fill it in with Google Sheets, Excel or LibreOffice (bit by bit is fine: whatever is missing shows in Spanish) and save it as CSV.
textos.3. Pruébala aquí mismo: Vírgula cambia a: 3. Try it right here: Vírgula changes instantly and you see how each text looks.
textos.4. Envíala por correo o GitHub. Tras la: 4. Send it by email or GitHub. After review, it is published for everyone.
textos.Archivo: WAV sin compresión, el sonido t: Archive: uncompressed WAV, the sound as it is (about 5.5 MB per minute in mono). Listening: light, with volume adjusted to be heard well (about 0.35 MB per minute).
textos.Ajustes del aparato (afectan también el: Device processing (also affects the archive audio)
textos.Para documentar, déjalos apagados: el ap: For documentation, leave them off: the device does not alter the sound. The listening audio raises its own volume without touching the archive.
textos.La plantilla decide qué campos tiene la: The template decides which fields the entry has. «Use» sets it for new recordings; each entry can change it.
textos.Derechos y licencia (se propone en cada: Rights and license (suggested in each entry)
textos.Ej. Uso comunitario y educativo; consult: E.g. Community and educational use; ask the community for other uses
textos.Ubicación al llenar la ficha: Location when filling in the entry
textos.La ubicación nunca se toma sola: solo cu: Location is never taken by itself: only when you tap 📍 in an entry.
textos.Recordarme respaldar después de: Remind me to back up after
textos.Vírgula guarda todo solo en este aparato: Vírgula keeps everything only on this device and uploads nothing to the internet. If the browser data is cleared or the device is lost, whatever was not exported is lost.
textos.Arma un informe técnico (aparato, versió: Builds a technical report (device, version, latest events) to send by email or GitHub. It does not include audio or entries.
textos.Todo se guarda en este aparato y no se e: Everything is kept on this device and sent nowhere. Protecting access to the device and to exported files is the responsibility of whoever records.
textos.En los códices mesoamericanos, la vírgul: In Mesoamerican codices, the vírgula is the scroll that comes out of the mouth of whoever speaks: every sound comes from someone.
textos.Diseñado y desarrollado por Alejandro Es: Designed and developed by Alejandro Estrada
The file is not a Vírgula language.
textos.Falta el código de la lengua (por ejempl: The language code is missing (for example: hch, nah, en).
textos.Termina la grabación antes de cambiar el: Finish the recording before changing the language.
textos.¿Quitar el idioma «{nombre}» de este apa: Remove the language «{nombre}» from this device?
There are no published languages yet.
textos.No se pudo consultar: revisa la conexión: Could not check: verify the internet connection.
textos.{n} texto(s) con variables distintas que: {n} text(s) with different variables stayed in Spanish.
textos.Código de la lengua (ISO 639; por ejempl: Language code (ISO 639; for example: hch for Wixárika, nah for Nahuatl, en for English)
textos.Nombre de la lengua, escrito en esa leng: Name of the language, written in that language
textos.Nombre de la lengua en español: Name of the language in Spanish
textos.Cómo escribir fechas y números (por ejem: How to write dates and numbers (for example: es-MX or en-US)
textos.Comunidad, autoridad o institución que r: Community, authority or institution that reviewed and endorses the translation
textos.Conserva igual lo que está entre llaves:: Keep what is between braces exactly the same: {x}
textos.La hoja necesita las columnas texto_orig: The sheet needs the columns texto_original and traduccion.
textos.⬇️ Plantilla en Descargas. Ábrela con Go: ⬇️ Template in Downloads. Open it with Google Sheets, Excel or LibreOffice; fill in the «traduccion» column and save it as CSV.
textos.Primero prueba tu traducción con «📥 Prob: First try your translation with «📥 Try my translation».
textos.Se guardó **{archivo}** en Descargas. En: **{archivo}** was saved in Downloads. Send it through one of these ways; the Vírgula team reviews it and publishes it for everyone.
textos.(Arrastra aquí el archivo para adjuntarl: (Drag the file here to attach it.)
textos.Por correo: adjunta el archivo antes de: By email: attach the file before sending. On GitHub: you need an account; drag the file into the message box.
textos.💾 Vírgula usa {usado}. Con estos ajustes: 💾 Vírgula uses {usado}. With these settings about {h} h {m} min more of recording fit.
textos.Se está grabando. ¿Ver otra sección? La: Recording in progress. See another section? The recording continues.
textos.El micrófono elegido no está conectado:: The chosen microphone is not connected: using the default.
textos.No se pudo usar el micrófono: {error}. R: Could not use the microphone: {error}. Check the microphone permission.
textos.no se pudo grabar en calidad de archivo:: could not record in archive quality: {error}
textos.este navegador no graba en calidad de co: this browser cannot record in listening quality
textos.de {desde} a {hasta} (posible llamada u: from {desde} to {hasta} (possible call or another app using the microphone)
textos.⚠️ No se pudo guardar: revisa el espacio: ⚠️ Could not save: check the device storage.
textos.faltan {s} s respecto al reloj: {s} s missing compared to the clock
textos.Muy bajo: acerca el micrófono (20–30 cm): Very low: move the microphone closer (20–30 cm)
textos.la app se cerró u ocultó: the app was closed or hidden
textos.se conectó o desconectó un micrófono: a microphone was connected or disconnected
textos.⚠️ {n} grabación(es) no se cerraron. Lo: ⚠️ {n} recording(s) were not closed. What was saved up to the last moment can be recovered.
textos.la grabación se cortó; se recuperó lo gu: the recording was cut off; what was saved was recovered
textos.Para cortar clips de una grabación de má: Cutting clips from a recording longer than 40 minutes requires archive quality.
textos.💾 {n} grabación(es) sin respaldo o con c: 💾 {n} recording(s) without backup or changed since the last one. Select them and use 📦 Export to keep them in Drive, on another computer or wherever you prefer.
textos.Todavía no hay grabaciones. Ve a ⏺ Graba: No recordings yet. Go to ⏺ Record.
textos.💾 {n} grabación(es) llevan más de {d} dí: 💾 {n} recording(s) have gone more than {d} day(s) without backup. They only exist on this device.
textos.Vocabulario, narraciones y conversacione: Vocabulary, narratives and conversations in a language, with transcription, translations and clips for the catalog.
textos.Lengua y variante; por ejemplo, wixárika: Language and variant; for example, Wixárika from San Andrés Cohamiata.
textos.Música, rituales, fiestas y saberes, con: Music, rituals, festivities and knowledge, with their use restrictions.
textos.Lo que la comunidad pide: qué no se debe: What the community asks: what must not be published, who may listen to it, on which dates…
textos.Notas habladas del día de trabajo: activ: Spoken notes of the workday: activities, observations and pending tasks.
Birds, frogs, insects, soundscapes. Also exports Darwin Core for biodiversity databases.
textos.Si no estás seguro, déjalo vacío o escri: If you are not sure, leave it empty or write only the genus.
textos.Entrevistas, grupos y sesiones (antropol: Interviews, groups and sessions (anthropology, psychology, education). Confidential from the start.
textos.Usa códigos (P01, P02…). La lista que re: Use codes (P01, P02…). Keep the list linking codes and names separately.
textos.{n} ficha(s) la usan: conservarán sus da: {n} entry(ies) use it: they will keep their data and be shown with the General template.
textos.⬇️ Plantilla guardada en Descargas. Comp: ⬇️ Template saved in Downloads. Share it with your team; they import it in ⚙️ Settings → 🧩 Templates.
It is not a Vírgula template.
textos.Ya tienes «{nombre}» v{v}, hecha en este: You already have «{nombre}» v{v}, made on this device. Replace it with the incoming v{v2}?
textos.El archivo no es una plantilla de Vírgul: The file is not a Vírgula template.
textos.Ya tenías «{nombre}» en esa versión o un: You already had «{nombre}» in that version or a newer one.
textos.🔒 Es una plantilla fija de equipo: se us: 🔒 This is a fixed team template: it is used as it is. To change it, duplicate it.
textos.Título, fecha y consentimiento son el nú: Title, date and consent are the core: they are always there. The rest is up to you. Hiding a field does not delete what is already written.
textos.Una sección oculta vuelve a aparecer en: A hidden section appears again in the entry if it already has data.
textos.🔒 Fija: quien la importe la usa tal cual: 🔒 Fixed: whoever imports it uses it as it is (they can duplicate it, not change it)
textos.Para compartirla: ⬇️ Exportar en la list: To share it: ⬇️ Export in the template list. Each time you save changes the version goes up; importing a newer version updates it.
textos.Campos de fábrica cargados: toca 💾 Guard: Factory fields loaded: tap 💾 Save to keep them.
textos.¿Quitar este campo de la plantilla? Lo y: Remove this field from the template? What is already written in the entries is kept (it appears in «Other data»).
textos.Ayuda para quien llena (opcional): Help for whoever fills it in (optional)
There is a custom field without a name.
There is already a template with that name.
textos.🔗 Enlazar a un adjunto o página: 🔗 Link to an attachment or page
textos.Qué se grabó, en qué contexto, quiénes p: What was recorded, in what context, who takes part…
textos.Confidencial: sin ubicación, participant: Confidential: no location, participants by code only and a warning before exporting.
textos.De otra plantilla o de un campo que ya n: From another template or from a field that is no longer in this one. They are kept and exported.
textos.Transcripción (lo que se dice, escrito e: Transcription (what is said, written in its language)
textos.Cada marca cortó un clip. Escribe su eti: Each mark cut a clip. Write its label (for example, the word that was said): on export, each clip gets that name, ready to bring into the language catalog.
textos.«No aplica» sirve, por ejemplo, para son: «Not applicable» is for, e.g., nature sounds or public spaces without identifiable people.
textos.Condiciones o notas (qué usos se aceptar: Conditions or notes (which uses were accepted, who gave it…)
textos.Fotos, documentos, letras, materiales… d: Photos, documents, lyrics, materials… of any kind. A copy is kept inside Vírgula.
textos.Ajustes pedidos: volumen automático {a},: Requested settings: automatic volume {a}, remove noise {b}, remove echo {c}
textos.Saturaciones: {a} · Huecos: {b} s · Tram: Clipping: {a} · Gaps: {b} s · Spans without audio: {c}
This device does not provide location.
textos.📍 Buscando ubicación… puede tardar al ai: 📍 Finding location… it may take a while outdoors.
textos.Comunidad, edad aproximada, otros datos: Community, approximate age, other data they agree to share
textos.Transcripción o nota del clip: Transcription or note of the clip
textos.Sin clips: esta grabación no tiene marca: No clips: this recording has no marks. You can cut clips by hand.
textos.Nota (qué es, quién lo hizo…): Note (what it is, who made it…)
textos.A un adjunto de esta grabación: To an attachment of this recording
textos.En el texto queda así: [palabras](adjunt: In the text it looks like this: [words](attachment) — on export, the link opens the file inside the package.
Write the words that will show.
textos.Elige un adjunto o escribe una dirección: Choose an attachment or write an address starting with https://
There is no audio left after the last clip.
textos.Firma con el dedo. Queda como adjunto «C: Sign with your finger. It is kept as a «Consent» attachment.
textos.Nombre o código de quien firma: Name or code of the signer
textos.Pide a la persona que diga su nombre (o: Ask the person to say their name (or code), the date and which uses they give permission for.
textos.¿Borrar «{titulo}» de este aparato, con: Delete «{titulo}» from this device, with its audio and attachments?
textos.¿Quitar este clip? El audio de la grabac: Remove this clip? The recording audio does not change.
textos.El paquete pasa de 4 GB. Elige «un paque: The package is over 4 GB. Choose «one package per recording» or fewer attachments.
🔒 {n} recording(s) are confidential. Share the package only with whoever should have it.
textos.📝 {n} ficha(s) tienen datos obligatorios: 📝 {n} entry(ies) have required fields not filled in.
textos.Sin audio completo (solo fichas y clips): No full audio (entries and clips only)
textos.🎯 WAV + Ogg, con nombre de su etiqueta (: 🎯 WAV + Ogg, named after their label (for the catalog)
textos.Los clips salen con el volumen ajustado: Clips come out with volume adjusted for listening. Their name is the label: the language catalog recognizes them with «📥 Bring audio in bulk».
textos.Datos de la ficha dentro de cada WAV (Br: Entry data inside each WAV (Broadcast WAV)
textos.Dublin Core (XML) para bibliotecas y rep: Dublin Core (XML) for libraries and repositories
textos.ELAN (.eaf): clips y transcripción aline: ELAN (.eaf): clips and transcription aligned to the audio
textos.Siempre van: indice.html para leer sin V: Always included: indice.html to read without Vírgula, fichas.json (complete), fichas.csv and clips.csv.
textos.✅ Cabe en WhatsApp como documento, corre: ✅ Fits in WhatsApp as a document, email (up to ~20 MB) or Drive.
textos.✅ WhatsApp como documento, Drive o cable: ✅ WhatsApp as a document, Drive or USB cable. Too big for email: use Drive.
textos.📁 Mejor Drive, cable USB o memoria. What: 📁 Better Drive, USB cable or memory card. WhatsApp accepts documents up to 2 GB but it may take long over mobile data.
textos.⚠️ Muy grande: elige «un paquete por gra: ⚠️ Very large: choose «one package per recording», «listening only» or fewer attachments. By cable or Drive over wifi.
textos.Referencia: 1 hora de archivo WAV mono ≈: Reference: 1 hour of mono WAV archive ≈ 330 MB; listening ≈ 21 MB. Before sharing, the device needs free space similar to the package size.
textos.Este navegador no deja compartir .zip di: This browser does not allow sharing .zip directly: save it and share it from Downloads or Files (WhatsApp, Drive, email…).
On a computer it goes to Downloads.
textos.Ahí, mantén presionado el paquete y toca: There, press and hold the package and tap **Share** (WhatsApp, Drive, email…). If the button opens nothing, go to the **Files** app → **Downloads**, or tap Chrome’s download notification.
textos.Está en la carpeta **Descargas** de la c: It is in the computer’s **Downloads** folder. From there you can upload it to Drive, attach it to an email or copy it to a memory stick.
textos.VÍRGULA · memoria sonora viva — paquete: VÍRGULA · living sound memory — recordings package
textos.Abre indice.html con cualquier navegador: Open indice.html with any browser to see the entries, listen to the audio and open the attachments (first extract or unzip the .zip).
textos.Las fichas para leer y escuchar, sin con: The entries, to read and listen to, offline.
textos.Todos los datos, completos. Es lo que le: All the data, complete. This is what Vírgula reads when importing this package.
textos.Una fila por grabación (se abre en Excel: One row per recording (opens in Excel, LibreOffice or Google Sheets).
textos.Audio completo: .wav = archivo (sin alte: Full audio: .wav = archive (unaltered, 16 bits); .webm/.m4a/.ogg = listening (light, adjusted volume).
textos.Clips con el nombre de su etiqueta: etiq: Clips named after their label: label__code-number. The language catalog recognizes them with «📥 Bring audio in bulk».
textos.Fotos, documentos y consentimientos, en: Photos, documents and consents, in one folder per recording.
textos.Dublin Core (dublin_core.xml) y, si apli: Dublin Core (dublin_core.xml) and, where applicable, Darwin Core (darwin_core folder, ready for GBIF/SNIB).
textos.Un archivo .eaf por grabación: ábrelo co: One .eaf file per recording: open it with ELAN together with the audios/ folder.
textos.Los WAV llevan dentro el título, la fech: The WAV files carry the title, date, code and rights inside (Broadcast WAV).
textos.Para volver a tener estas grabaciones en: To have these recordings in Vírgula again: 📚 Archive → 📥 Import package.
textos.Respeta las condiciones de consentimient: Respect the consent and rights conditions noted in each entry.
Respect the consent and rights conditions of each entry.
It does not look like a .zip file.
textos.Este .zip es de más de 4 GB (zip64); Vír: This .zip is over 4 GB (zip64); Vírgula cannot read it yet.
textos.El paquete no tiene fichas.json: no es u: The package has no fichas.json: it is not a Vírgula package.
textos.fichas.json no tiene el formato de Vírgu: fichas.json does not have the Vírgula format.
textos.Dejar como están las {n} que ya tengo: Leave the {n} I already have as they are
textos.Reemplazarlas con las del paquete: Replace them with the ones in the package
textos.Trae {n} plantilla(s); las que no tengas: Brings {n} template(s); the ones you do not have are added.
textos.falta la consulta de «{titulo}»: the listening audio of «{titulo}» is missing
textos.{n} adjunto(s) no venían en el paquete: {n} attachment(s) were not in the package
textos.¿Qué pasó? ¿Qué estabas haciendo?: What happened? What were you doing?
textos.Se agregan datos técnicos: versión, apar: Technical data is added: version, device, browser, storage, recording settings and recent errors. No audio, entries or names are included.
textos.Revisa el texto antes de enviarlo. Si es: Check the text before sending it. If it is long, the email carries only the beginning: attach the saved report.
✨ There is a new version of Vírgula.
textos.⚠️ Este navegador no deja guardar datos: ⚠️ This browser does not allow saving data (private window?). Vírgula needs to save on the device.
